label: Diagram 24
caption: Diagram 24 An example of a shower room incorporating a corner WC for individual use
description: This is a plan (top-down) view of a rectangular shower room, overall 2400mm wide by 2500mm deep. The diagram is titled "Diagram 24 An example of a shower room incorporating a corner WC for individual use". At the top of the plan a 500mm horizontal dimension and a 300mm vertical dimension relate to the box labelled "Tip-up seat". On the left wall, from top down, labels read "Floor drain", "Alarm pull cord", "Vertical grab rail" and "Towel rail". The upper-right wall shows a "Mirror" and a wavy line for the "Shower curtain". In the centre of the room a label "Drop-down rails" has an arrow pointing to the dashed rail. On the right-hand side a "Washbasin" is set above a corner WC, with a 140–160mm dimension between the two. Inside the room a diagonal arrow indicates the "Fall of floor" and a square area in the lower-left is marked "1500mm x 1500mm wheelchair turning space". A door is shown on the bottom wall towards the left, drawn in the open position. A top note refers to Diagram 23 for the arrangement of shower controls; a bottom-right note refers to Diagram 18 for the corner WC and states the larger basin is set back 200mm. A bottom note reads "Layout shown for right-hand transfer to shower seat and WC".
